sources.title: Normal Contact Without Adhesion
sources.access: Publisher full HTML read, sections 2.3 and 2.5.10
sources.used: Axisymmetric linear elastic non-adhesive contact, MDR transform and truncated paraboloid equation 2.78. Sharp rim stress singularity explicitly retained as limitation.
sources.not_proved: Finite polymer branches, temperature dependent creep, wear evolution and ski edge release.

sources.journal_authors: Li, Forsbach, Schuster, Pielsticker and Popov
sources.title: Wear Analysis of a Heterogeneous Annular Cylinder
sources.access: Publisher page unavailable; author preprint PDF full text read, printed page 8 visually checked.
sources.used: Constant recession in full contact requires dimensional specific wear coefficient times pressure to be equal. Same elastic modulus, persistent contact, fixed area and constant sliding velocity are assumptions.
sources.source_audit: Preprint page 8 printed equation 22 lacks radial factor r; equation 25 prints an extra 2pi before an angular integral. Our force balance independently uses F=2pi integral[p(r) r dr]. No claim that the final journal version retains these printing issues.
sources.not_proved: Random mixture area exposure, transient roughness, actual PHAs or outdoor wet wear; steady shape still loses mass.

sources.authors: Dunn, Steffens, Burris, Banks and Sawyer
sources.title: Spatial geometric effects on the friction coefficients of UHMWPe
sources.access: Author-hosted 6-page article-in-press PDF read; table 2 visually verified. Final publication Wear 264 (2008) 648–653 per author bibliography, whereas PDF header says 2007.
sources.used: Sliding direction can alter friction; selected dry/water line/chirp averages retained only as source observations.
sources.conditions: UHMWPE pins against polished CoCr, average speed 50.8 mm/s, typical 203 N and nominal 10 MPa for Fig 4. Methods dry approx 26 C, table 1 temperatures 28/35 C, heated bath target 37 C; per-row temperatures not resolved. Table 2 path-length entries 50.8/25.4 mm differ from table 1 range 300–650 mm.
sources.not_used: No coefficient, temperature or direction multiplier transferred to a 50 C ski sole. Reported friction ratios are not wear ratios. Bovine-serum lubrication is not a candidate.

sources.title: Semi-analytical calculation model for friction of polymers on the example of POM / PE-UHMW and steel / PE-UHMW
sources.access: Prior cycle 33 verified full-text record and cycle 41 restatement used for provenance of tau=tau0+beta*p. This cycle numerical tau0=0.2 MPa beta=0.03 remain hypothetical, not fitted from this source.
sources.not_proved: Chosen interface coefficients, shape changes, high speed, 50 C, biological/environmental safety.
